about_the_game:
On its way down, you need to smash everything that stands in its path!!! Savor the ultimate thrill of crushing everything in your way!

Crushing the little figures along the road will increase the boulder's size and weight, granting it greater acceleration and diving force!

A Variety of Levels, Choose as You Like

There are nearly 20 levels, with different scenes such as forests, villages, caves, and sewers. The full version will feature an endless mode!

Exquisitely Polished Physics-Based Shattering Effects and Collision Feedback

The game features vivid physics-driven shattering effects. Smashing different objects and varying collision forces will both affect the shattering feedback. Combined with appropriate sound effects and screen shaking, it delivers an immersive audio-visual experience and a satisfying sense of stress relief.

Multiple Interactive Mechanisms

Want to clear a path for the boulder? Try out these abilities at your disposal:

  • Tap the boulder to push it forward

  • Tap obstacles to destroy them

  • Tap and drag the boulder to set a direction for pushing

Unique Cartoon Style and Rendering

The boulder and scenes in the game have unique characteristics. The addition of post-processing filters and camera shaking effects makes the gaming experience excellent.
